user.title: Configure Bosch BTH-RM / BTH-RA and AHC
user.description: Controlled BETA. Select ONE AHC schedule. Radiator climate and operating-mode select lists must be in exactly the same order; each pair must belong to the same HA device. Output is OFF on every start and requires explicit enabling via a switch. The AHC automation is optional during initial setup; select it later with Configure after the virtual climate exists.
